title: Page designer canvas draws a location field as "[Object]" and a select value raw when an authored record:details names its fields
body:
## Observed

In Studio's page designer, the Design canvas of a `full` record page whose `record:details` block names its fields draws a `location` field's value as the literal `[Object]` and a `select` field's value as its raw stored value (`amer` instead of the option label). The runtime record page draws both correctly; only the designer canvas is wrong.

Evidence: `e4-after-convert-to-full.png` on the never-merged branch `claude/issue-27054-evidence` (commit `bf202d60`; HEADQUARTERS shows `[Object]`, SALES REGION shows `amer`), taken on the showcase app from PR #27163's branch. The same output comes from the full-create seed that is already on `main`, so this is pre-existing, not introduced by #27163.

## Reach

Public door: Studio → page designer → Design canvas of any `full` record page with an authored `record:details` block (every page created through the metadata page-create form with `kind: full`, and every page converted with "Convert to full page" after #27163). Reproduced on the showcase app.

## Expected

The canvas renders field values through the same value formatters the record page uses (`location` → formatted address, `select` → option label), or draws a typed placeholder, never `[Object]` or a raw code.

## Dedupe words

page designer canvas record:details authored field names [Object] location select raw value
